title: Enhanced Relative Localization Based on Persistent Excitation for Multi-UAVs in GPS-Denied Environments
authors: F. She; Y. Zhang; D. Shi; H. Zhou; X. Ren; T. Xu
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
